mapper.select: SELECT id, elder_no as elderNo, name, gender, birth_date as birthDate, age, id_card as idCard, phone, address, contact_name as contactName, contact_phone as contactPhone, contact_relation as contactRelation, health_status as healthStatus, care_level as careLevel, status, bed_no as bedNo, check_in_date as checkInDate FROM elder WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND status = 'CHECKED_IN' ORDER BY bed_no
